B1 magazine is "magazine" and is spelled like this prompt; "periodical" is a rarer English word and fits both Dutch words. tijdschrift is the everyday word.
The A2 sense in Work and education is the school report; the Turkish has "karne". A bare "report" reads as a written report (verslag).
The category is Health and body, where testen is a medical test ("laten testen op corona"); the hint "(try out)" points to the product sense. The hint is needed (B1 toetsen is "to test").
"unexpectedly" repeats the verb's meaning and does not separate it from A1 verbazen "to surprise". The A2 use is "iemand verrassen met een cadeau"; the Turkish "sürpriz yapmak" has the same sense.
